run_play_minihack_env: run a MiniHack NetHack environment episode with human or random control mode
run_play_raw_nethack: run a raw NetHack environment and save ttyrec data to a directory
run_play_save_gif: run a MiniHack episode and save a GIF replay of the trajectory
run_play_random_mode: run a MiniHack environment in random action mode for multiple episodes
run_play_debug_mode: run a MiniHack environment with debug mode enabled to drop into ipdb on exceptions
